data.description: Sky-High Luxury: Stunning 1-4 Bedroom Apartments with Burj Khalifa Views
data.display_address: Tiger Sky Tower, Business Bay, Dubai
data.long_description:
Tiger Sky Tower, the tallest residential building globally, is a stunning feat of architecture that offers extraordinary living spaces. Home to the highest swimming pool in the world, it offers breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa. Residents can enjoy a lush indoor rainforest, a dynamic playground with a rollglider, and an exclusive dining experience within the tower. With its iconic design, prime location, and awe-inspiring views, Tiger Sky Tower provides a lifestyle of unmatched luxury.

This 122-storey landmark redefines both sophistication and comfort, transforming everyday living into an extraordinary experience.

Located in the thriving Business Bay district, Tiger Sky Tower provides residents with an unparalleled living experience. A variety of top-tier amenities are offered, including shopping, multiple swimming pools, playgrounds, and fast elevators. The modern residences, ranging from 1-4 bedroom apartments, boast contemporary architecture and kitchens equipped with the latest technology.

With easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, traveling around Dubai is effortless. The tower is just 8 minutes from the Dubai Design District, 10 minutes from Dubai Mall, Dubai Opera, and Bay Square, and 15 minutes from Jumeirah Beach and Ras Al Khor Nature Reserve. Its central location ensures a lively, vibrant lifestyle at the heart of Dubai.
